content.body:
This is the contextual help system. The first time you visit any screen or tab, you will be presented with a window like this describing the screen.
You will only see each help window once, but you can review any help window at any time by clicking on the ? button at the top right of any screen.
Click Index to see a list of all the help windows for the current screen.
The "tail" of each help window will point to the area of the relevant are of the screen.
You can close a help window by clicking the Close button at the bottom of the help window.
